title: Declare spacy and tokenizers, or skip cleanly when absent (for BD-d9f811)
description: Add tokenizers to the extras it belongs in; make the tests that need spacy or a local model cache skip with a clear reason when the dependency is missing; make install's comment must match what it installs.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged to develop in PR #93. Root cause of the 21 mismatches: the byte-for-byte test compared one engine's row against a study file holding three engines' rows; it is now parametrised per engine. tokenizers declared, make install installs dev and build, CI and pytest cover tests/.
